**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **Customer convenience right** — § 9.4 permits termination of the Agreement *or any Order Form* without cause.
- **Notice** — § 29.4 sets the § 9.4 period at thirty days before the effective termination date, by the written methods in § 29.1.
- **No exit penalty** — we owe "only accrued Fees"; no early-termination fee appears anywhere (§ 7.7 is a late-payment charge, a separate rule).
- **Pro-rata refund** — § 9.4 plus § 10.2 require refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period.
- **No Vendor convenience right** — Vendor may terminate only for uncured material breach (§ 9.1) or insolvency (§ 9.2); § 20.5 bars terminating unaffected Services and § 24.4 bars termination on our change of control.

No redline proposed.
